passes.summary: Kernel, module contract, reference module, memory system, CI and ADR baseline.
Master plan, parity matrix and roadmap approved; the rejected plan shapes recorded.
Postgres data spine, settings repository, Redis cooldowns, BullMQ worker, telemetry and /setup.
P1 audit: shared retry policy, setup permission proof and a worker Redis readiness ping.
Moderation cases, /mod, scanner, native AutoMod plan, appeals, security, quarantine and /verify.
P2 audit and case-store proofs; live Discord actions remain explicitly unproven.
Community suite: leveling, economy, reaction roles, welcome, starboard, tickets, giveaways and content.
AI provider, hard guild caps, exact-index RAG, deflection, explanations, summaries and classification.
Economy hardening: ledger-derived balances, guild lock, stable idempotency keys and explicit refusals.
Baseline commit, six research pages, memory v2 machine files, renderer and extended checks.
Channel resolver, all nine fetch sites migrated, obfuscation fixture and audit:channels.
Required/optional intents, INTENT_PROFILE, /setup capability report, audit:intents and P4.5 close.
Portability: export bundle, transactional restore, rollback, deletion receipts, level/transcript importers and drift report.
First live run: AI Team#5758 online, 10 commands registered, Qwen3:8b mention replies in #ai-chat; dev-only test seam and think:false adapter.
Dev-only prefix bridge and live command proof; bot-authored mention chat gated to DEV_GUILD_ID; /ticket stats ordering fixed; clear-then-register command sync with read-back.
Public release packaging: Keystone repo, README/AGENTS, AGPL-3.0 licence, safe drift-only command sync and explicit resync.
P6 dashboard/API foundation: OAuth2/PKCE sessions, BigInt guild authz with bot membership, read-only HTML/API reads, Postgres stores and no-paid-service rule.
P6 settings writes: CSRF-protected dashboard form and PATCH API through SettingsService, module Zod validation, cross-guild/non-admin/bot-absent tests.
Invite tracking: cached-counter attribution, durable invite_joins, /invites leaderboard|stats|who and advisory flags; live 11-command registration and dev-bridge run.
Cold-cache invite attribution records no inviter; unused refresh-token storage removed; command-sync and MEE6 claims corrected.
Invite gateway boundary: a gateway-independent tracker owns cache, queue and decisions; discord.js wiring is a translation layer with a direct serialization test.
Dashboard server boundaries: ordered route table, per-area handlers, one session context, shared render/http modules and one settings-write CSRF gate.
Link/phishing filter: local host blocklist and punycode detection in the security engine, /mod links review queue, and a dev marker seam for MCP-driven live proof.
Profanity/zalgo filter: operator-owned banned words on Unicode word edges, a combining-mark threshold, /mod filters review action, and the live delete-mode link proof.

Auto-responder: exact/contains/regex triggers in the community record seam, one reply with deterministic precedence, per-trigger cooldowns and /tools admin actions; live gateway proof plus a live profanity delete-mode proof.

Command tree: every existing hub now registers real Discord subcommands (12 roots, 77 subcommands), `/help` reads the live registry, the catalog is generated, and boot sync plus commands:doctor compare the full option shape instead of names alone.

Environment check plus synthetic slash harness: real nested /mod ban through asInteractionLike and dispatch, exact local Postgres/Redis blocker errors, Ollama warm retry, and a duplicate-process fix verified by one-reply MCP transcript.
